params.name: CampaignId
params.description: The ID of the campaign (program) the click belongs to.

params.name: ClickId
params.description: The generated click ID (`im_ref`) representing the consumer journey.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific click event by its ID (`im_ref`). Note that a single ID can be associated with multiple click objects, representing a single consumer journey.

params.name: ProgramId
params.description: The ID of the program (campaign) to export clicks from.

params.name: AdId
params.description: ID of the ad that was clicked. Can be repeated for multiple ads.

params.name: Date
params.description: The date for the clicks to be exported, in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format. Defaults to today. Only dates after April 9, 2024 are supported.

params.name: MediaId
params.description: The unique ID of the partner. Can be repeated for multiple partners.

params.name: UniqueClick
params.description: Filter for clicks that follow IAB standards for a unique click.

params.name: ResultFormat
params.description: The desired file format for the export.

items.docs: Schedules a job to export daily clicks. It returns a URI to poll for job status updates and a URI to download the exported file once the job is complete.
